description: This file defines the DateFormat class used for handling custom date format parsing and validation within the project. It includes logic for checking the format string and throws validation exceptions if the format is invalid.

classes.name: DateFormat
classes.description: A utility class for representing and validating date format strings used within the application.

methods.name: DateFormat
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DateFormat object, validating and normalizing the provided raw date format string.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given date format string by attempting to create a DateTimeFormatter with strict resolver style.
